_meta.batch: Symmetry CLUE X (~53 sceny, 347 terminow) - reakcje Symmetry (iluzjonistka, archaiczny szekspirowski rejestr) na kazdy dowod w grze. Zachowano archaiczna polszczyzne (inwersje, 'zaiste/wszak/azaliz/iz/prithee->blagam') konsekwentnie z ustalonym rejestrem postaci (batch_27-31).
_meta.character_voice: Symmetry: kontynuacja archaicznego, szekspirowskiego rejestru (inwersja szyku, 'wszak/zaiste/azaliz/iz/tys/mine/thou'->polskie odpowiedniki archaizujace).
_meta.uwagi: Dump tym razem czytany BEZ uzycia Python repr() (nauka z bledu batch_63) - stringi en skopiowane bezposrednio ze zrodla, bez ryzyka nadmiarowych cudzyslowow.

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ActionFigure/.en: Or doth it bear the form of former fallen captain?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ActionFigure/.pl: Czy może formę nosi dawnego, poległego kapitana?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ActionFigure/.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BalloonBasket.en: Ah, there lies the picture of the cane. Beperched-upon by little hat!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BalloonBasket.pl: Ach, oto wizerunek laski. Uwieńczonej małym kapeluszem!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BalloonBasket.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BalloonBasket.en: But wait; is it of-a-one with that in [i]current[/i] Godrik's grasp?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BalloonBasket.pl: Lecz zaczekaj; czyż jedno to samo, co w dłoni [i]obecnego[/i] Godrika?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BalloonBasket.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BalloonBasket.en: [h]I[/h] used to be beperched-upon by little hat...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BalloonBasket.pl: [h]Ja[/h] też kiedyś byłem uwieńczony małym kapeluszem...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BalloonBasket.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.en: I cannot turn mine eyes, what lies within!?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.pl: Nie mogę oderwać oczu, co kryje się w środku!?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.en: We're still trying to work that out. Any guesses?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.pl: Wciąż próbujemy to rozgryźć. Masz jakieś przypuszczenia?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.en: Surely some solemn secret, dark and dreadful.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.pl: Z pewnością jakaś uroczysta tajemnica, mroczna i straszliwa.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.en: Oh it [i]better[/i] be, after all this.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.pl: Och, [i]lepiej[/i] żeby tak było, po tym wszystkim.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlackBox/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.en: A werewolf? Or some hell-born fiend?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.pl: Wilkołak? Czy jakiś demon zrodzony z piekła?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.en: - I think it's just a guy.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.en: But his eyes! They burn of wicked flame!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.pl: Lecz jego oczy! Płoną złowrogim płomieniem!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.en: Well, it's either [i]wicked flame[/i], or it's just red eye from using a flash in low light.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.pl: Cóż, to albo [i]złowrogi płomień,[/i] albo po prostu czerwone oczy od lampy błyskowej w słabym świetle.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BlurryPhoto/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BrokenCompass.en: The compass lies on deathbed dark, its many-pointed bones askew.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BrokenCompass.pl: Kompas na mrocznym łożu śmierci leży, jego wieloramienne kości wykrzywione.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BrokenCompass.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BrokenCompass.en: Hush! It now endures a surgeon's steady hand.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BrokenCompass.pl: Cicho! Znosi teraz pewną dłoń chirurga.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE BrokenCompass.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.en: Really? When did she [i]make[/i] this request?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.en: Both she and I hath mothers lost... and both a token keep.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.pl: Zarówno ona, jak i ja matki straciłyśmy... i obie pamiątkę zachowujemy.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.pl: Inaczej niż [i]ty,[/i] jednak, Sinthia swojej nie [i]nosi.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.en: Sinthia's already [i]got[/i] a cool jacket. One that actually fits her, too.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.pl: Sinthia [i]ma[/i] już fajną kurtkę. Taką, która na dodatek na nią pasuje.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.en: And stitched it [i]I[/i] - at her request - with mine own hand!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.pl: A uszyłam ją [i]ja[/i] - na jej prośbę - własnoręcznie!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsJacke.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsLog/S.en: The numbers spoken by the ship - they falter, flailing, weird and wild!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsLog/S.pl: Liczby wypowiadane przez statek - chwieją się, miotają, dziwne i dzikie!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsLog/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsLog/S.en: ...as if she seeks to speak, yet lacks the tongue to voice her troubled thought.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsLog/S.pl: ...jakby pragnęła przemówić, lecz brak jej języka, by wyrazić swą trwożną myśl.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaptainsLog/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaretakersJou.en: Kindly close the book. I've no desire to look upon it longer.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaretakersJou.pl: Bądź łaskaw zamknąć księgę. Nie pragnę dłużej na to patrzeć.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaretakersJou.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaretakersJou.en: -I didn't know it had a name.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaretakersJou.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaretakersJou.en: Mine eye but chanced upon it. Nothing more.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaretakersJou.pl: Me oko jedynie na to natrafiło. Nic więcej.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaretakersJou.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.en: The letter in fair Sinthia's hand... a plan devised by her and her alone.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.pl: List w dłoni pięknej Sinthii... plan uknuty przez nią, i tylko przez nią.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.en: Why, to hire a sleuth to seek the truth!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.pl: Ależ, by wynająć detektywa, co prawdy poszuka!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.en: That's us. Couple of sleuths, seeking the truth.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.pl: To my. Para detektywów, szukających prawdy.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.en: I implore, unravel swift this tangled tale - and name the knave ere further harm befall!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.pl: Błagam, rozwikłajcie prędko tę splątaną opowieść - i wskażcie łotra, nim dalsza krzywda się stanie!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.en: With former captain slain... I fear'd the [i]new[/i] be target [i]two[/i]!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.pl: Gdy dawny kapitan zabity... obawiałam się, że [i]nowy[/i] też celem [i]będzie![/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CaseFile/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CellPhone/Sec.en: Employ'd it be... to speak with unseeable souls?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CellPhone/Sec.pl: Użyto go... by mówić z duszami niewidzialnymi?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CellPhone/Sec.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CellPhone/Sec.en: Who'd have thought that Dansom Dirk, of all our kin, is playing host to hidden ghost!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CellPhone/Sec.pl: Któż by pomyślał, że Dansom Dirk, spośród nas wszystkich, gospodarzem jest ukrytego ducha!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CellPhone/Sec.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CommandContra.en: I saw her running from the bridge - all pages clasped in hand.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CommandContra.pl: Widziałam, jak biegła z mostku - wszystkie strony w dłoni ściskając.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CommandContra.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CommandContra.pl: W pospiesznym, gnanym pośpiechu, do [i]sypialni[/i] zmierzała.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CommandContra.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CommandContra.en: D'you remember when Sinthia first got hold of this?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CommandContra.pl: Pamiętasz, kiedy Sinthia po raz pierwszy to zdobyła?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CommandContra.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.en: This cauldron to Mortuga held [i]deep worth[/i], it seemed to me.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.pl: Ten kocioł dla Mortugi miał [i]głęboką wartość,[/i] tak mi się zdawało.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.en: When speaking of it's somber form, his words were most severe.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.pl: Gdy mówił o jego posępnym kształcie, słowa jego były nader surowe.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.en: What did he say about it?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.en: [i]'Lay not thy hand upon its lid! Lest thou be bound to ceaseless sorrow![/i]'
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.pl: [i]'Nie kładź dłoni swej na jego wieku! Bo skazany będziesz na wieczysty żal![/i]'
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE CurseCauldron.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DivingLicense.en: Dost thou require this card’s [h]consent[/h], when saving souls from drowning deep?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DivingLicense.pl: Czy potrzebujesz tej karty [h]zgody,[/h] by ratować dusze z topieli głębokiej?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DivingLicense.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DivingLicense.en: Then what purpose doth it serve?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DivingLicense.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DreamHelmet/S.en: D'you know how Zephyr's [i]Dream Helmet[/i] works?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DreamHelmet/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DreamHelmet/S.en: H-his secrets are his own to keep.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DreamHelmet/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DreamHelmet/S.en: I am bound to share them not!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DreamHelmet/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DreamHelmet/S.en: Okay, but - just for the record, you do [h]know[/h] his secrets?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DreamHelmet/S.pl: Okej, ale - tak dla wiadomości, ty [h]znasz[/h] jego sekrety?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DreamHelmet/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.en: That little dapper hat he wears - I sewed myself from cotton cloth!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.pl: Ten mały elegancki kapelusz, co nosi - uszyłam sama z bawełnianej tkaniny!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.en: ...and you thought he should have a hat just because [i]Gripp[/i] wears one?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.pl: ...i pomyślałaś, że powinien mieć kapelusz, bo [i]Gripp[/i] taki nosi?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.en: Nay, was naught but wood becarved - a simple stick with face adorn'd.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.pl: Nie, był jedynie drewnem rzeźbionym - prostym kijem, obliczem zdobionym.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.en: The cane didn't [i]always[/i] have a hat?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.en: And now he [i]truly[/i] looks the part, mirrored to his master’s garb.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.pl: A teraz [i]doprawdy[/i] wygląda jak trzeba, odbiciem szat swego pana.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.en: No... I saw a picture of it. At least I think I did.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.pl: Nie... widziałam obraz tego. Przynajmniej tak sądzę.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE DriftwoodCane.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.en: A portrait of fair Sinthia’s... youth...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.en: A sorry-sorrow'd tale has she, for never fully wrought.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.pl: Smutną-żałosną opowieść ma ona, nigdy w pełni nieopowiedzianą.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.en: Mine eye is drawn against my will, to she that lingers far from frame...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.pl: Me oko wbrew mej woli przyciągane jest ku tej, co z dala od kadru trwa...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.en: Left to rust in stillborn state, a dream forever gone undreamt.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.pl: Pozostawiony rdzewieć w martwym stanie, sen na zawsze nieprześniony.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FamilyPhoto/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FeliciaPainti.en: I think they're just [i]ship masts[/i] - like she's standing by the harbor.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FeliciaPainti.pl: Myślę, że to po prostu [i]maszty statków[/i] - jakby stała przy porcie.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FeliciaPainti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FeliciaPainti.en: A yearning, stir'd along by grief, to seek, to find, a path, a bridge -  to cross that dark divide.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FeliciaPainti.pl: Tęsknota, żalem wzburzona, by szukać, znaleźć, ścieżkę, most -  by przekroczyć tę mroczną przepaść.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FeliciaPainti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FeliciaPainti.en: I assume she's dead, this woman.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FeliciaPainti.pl: Zakładam, że nie żyje, ta kobieta.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FeliciaPainti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FilmProjector.en: Mortuga owned a projector? What for? Projecting a - film, I guess?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FilmProjector.pl: Mortuga miał projektor? Po co? Żeby wyświetlać - film, jak sądzę?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FilmProjector.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FogBall/Secti.en: You wouldn't have. He - lives inside the ball.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FogBall/Secti.pl: Nie znałbyś go. On - mieszka wewnątrz kuli.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FogBall/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FogBall/Secti.en: Well… thou may’st use it... to speak with Gregory.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FogBall/Secti.pl: Cóż... możesz jej użyć... by mówić z Gregorym.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE FogBall/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GlassEyeball/.en: ...I'm not sure if that was a pun or not.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GlassEyeball/.pl: ...nie jestem pewna, czy to był kalambur.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GlassEyeball/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GlassEyeball/.en: Um... in the Parlor, on the floor.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GlassEyeball/.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.en: The question that bestirs my soul.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.en: I dearly hope to ask her, and know the truth at last.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.pl: Żarliwie pragnę ją zapytać, i poznać prawdę wreszcie.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.en: T'was my mother’s own... or so I'm told.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.pl: Był matki mej własny... a tak przynajmniej mi powiedziano.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.en: I was too young. I don't remember.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.en: Do you... think you ever will?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE GoldenLocket/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.en: How it blinks and flickers so!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.en: As if it sought to speak with kin!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.en: It's just broken - I think it's turning itself on and off.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.pl: Jest po prostu zepsute - myślę, że samo się włącza i wyłącza.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.en: It's a radio, I'm not sure it [i]has[/i] 'kin'.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.pl: To radio, nie jestem pewna, czy [i]ma[/i] 'krewnych'.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandheldRadio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandwrittenLe.en: What makes you think it's a woman?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandwrittenLe.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandwrittenLe.en: We don't really know who they-
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandwrittenLe.pl: Tak naprawdę nie wiemy, kim oni-
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HandwrittenLe.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HexBottle/Sec.en: Hey, Sym - d'you know anything about this-
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HexBottle/Sec.pl: Hej, Sym - wiesz coś o tym-
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HexBottle/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HexoftheHelms.en: Oh, cool. Hey - did you like the bit when-
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HexoftheHelms.pl: Och, super. Hej - podobał ci się fragment, kiedy-
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HexoftheHelms.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HexoftheHelms.en: I am but midway through. Prithee, spoil it not!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HexoftheHelms.pl: Jestem dopiero w połowie. Błagam, nie zdradzaj!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE HexoftheHelms.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.en: Yeah. I thought maybe it was part of some kind of trick? or an illusion?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.pl: Tak. Pomyślałem, może to część jakiejś sztuczki? Czy iluzji?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.en: I didn't hang it upside-down. I hung it right-side-up.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.pl: Nie powiesiłam tego do góry nogami. Powiesiłam to jak trzeba.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.en: Plans for a new magic act?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.pl: Czemu powiesiłaś to do góry nogami?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.en: And you hung it up on the wall? in the Illusion Theatre?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.pl: I powiesiłaś to na ścianie? W Teatrze Iluzji?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.en: I - fully meant to take it down, but never had the chance...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.pl: Ja - zamierzałam to zdjąć, lecz nigdy nie miałam okazji...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IllusionistPo.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE InnDeeds/Sect.en: Something in it holds great weight - for [i]her[/i], at least, it seems.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE InnDeeds/Sect.pl: Coś w tym wielką wagę ma - dla [i]niej,[/i] przynajmniej, tak się zdaje.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE InnDeeds/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE InnDeeds/Sect.en: 'Twas Sinthia who had it, when first she came aboard....
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE InnDeeds/Sect.pl: To Sinthia to miała, gdy pierwszy raz na pokład wstąpiła...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE InnDeeds/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE InnDeeds/Sect.en: With certain mind I cannot say.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE InnDeeds/Sect.pl: Z pewnością umysłu rzec nie mogę.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE InnDeeds/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.pl: By mieszkać pod ciężką, żelazną odlaną rzeczą...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.en: Ever-poised for rope to snap? Ever-set to fall?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.pl: Wciąż gotową, by lina pękła? Wciąż skłonną, by runąć?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.en: Mortuga? He didn't [i]'dwell beneath'[/i] it. Not really.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.pl: Mortuga? On nie [i]'mieszkał pod'[/i] tym. Nie do końca.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.en: I dunno, it's hanging [i]directly[/i] over his desk. That's a choice.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.pl: Nie wiem, wisi [i]bezpośrednio[/i] nad jego biurkiem. To wybór.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE IronBell/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.en: Oh. Then - how does it work?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.en: Speaking of - Sym, can the [i]doll[/i] talk? Like - does it have a little speaker inside?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.pl: A skoro już o tym mowa - Sym, czy [i]lalka[/i] potrafi mówić? Znaczy - ma w środku mały głośnik?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.en: I just thought - you know - there's a [i]string[/i] on the back. I thought it was like a [i]pullstring.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.pl: Po prostu pomyślałam - no wiesz - z tyłu jest [i]sznurek.[/i] Myślałam, że to jak [i]sznurek do pociągania.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.en:
She is ever-silent.
I speak for us both.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.pl:
Ona jest wiecznie milcząca.
Ja mówię za nas obie.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE LifesizeDoll/.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.en: I find it hard to look away...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.en: Her flicker-flame doth draw me in, and I am merest moth.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.pl: Jej migotliwy płomień przyciąga mnie, a jam jest jedynie ćmą.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.en:
No, not of the sea.
She's of an even darker place.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.pl:
Nie, nie z morza.
Ona jest z miejsca jeszcze mroczniejszego.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.en: What is it? Some kinda monster from the bottom of the ocean?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.pl: Co to jest? Jakiś potwór z dna oceanu?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MermaidPainti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MessageinaBot.en: I thought it was a piece of [i]paper.[/i] Shows what I know.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MessageinaBot.pl: Myślałam, że to kawałek [i]papieru.[/i] Widać, co ja wiem.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MessageinaBot.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ModelTown/Sec.en: Oh! That's my house! Right there.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ModelTown/Sec.pl: Och! To mój dom! Tuż tam.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ModelTown/Sec.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ModelTown/Sec.en: Yeah - the theatre, where I lived?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ModelTown/Sec.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MoonVial/Sect.en: I do not know, and dare not guess!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MoonVial/Sect.pl: Nie wiem, i zgadywać się nie ośmielam!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MoonVial/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MoonVial/Sect.en: It's not my place to muse upon the things in Chamber Dream!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MoonVial/Sect.pl: Nie moim jest miejscem rozmyślać nad rzeczami z Komnaty Snów!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MoonVial/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.en: [i]Glad[/i] was he to see it gone!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.pl: [i]Rad[/i] był, gdy zniknęło z jego oczu!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.en: Kind of him to lend it to you.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.pl: Miło z jego strony, że ci to pożyczył.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.en: Yeah, I'd imagine it's kinda precious to him.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.pl: Tak, wyobrażam sobie, że to dla niego dość cenne.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.en: O contraire - he spoke of it with sulk and scorn!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.pl: O, przeciwnie - mówił o tym z gniewem i pogardą!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE MovieMagazine.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.en: There were other things I wished to learn. Things not found upon that stage.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.pl: Były inne rzeczy, które pragnęłam poznać. Rzeczy, których nie znaleźć na tej scenie.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.en: O, long-faded yesteryear - I'm shocked you knew that [i]she[/i] was [i]me![/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.pl: O, dawno wyblakłe lata minione - zdumiona jestem, że wiedzieliście, iż [i]ona[/i] była [i]mną![/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.en: I'm not sure you're old enough to say 'yesteryear' - in [i]any[/i] context.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.pl: Nie jestem pewien, czy jesteś dość stara, żeby mówić 'lata minione' - w [i]jakimkolwiek[/i] kontekście.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.en: From the review, it sounds like your old magic show was pretty good.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.pl: Z recenzji wynika, że twój dawny pokaz magii był całkiem niezły.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.en: I filled the house up every night.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.en: So why'd you give it up?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE NewspaperPage.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Pocketbook/Se.en: No - ah, no, I... meant the bloodstain.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Pocketbook/Se.pl: Nie - ach, nie, ja... miałem na myśli krwawą plamę.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Pocketbook/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE RaggedCloth/S.en: It was hung up on the wall in the Illusion Theatre.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE RaggedCloth/S.pl: Wisiało to na ścianie w Teatrze Iluzji.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE RaggedCloth/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE RaggedCloth/S.en: We thought maybe you were [i]'The Stargazing Girl.'[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE RaggedCloth/S.pl: Pomyśleliśmy, że może byłaś [i]'Dziewczyną Patrzącą w Gwiazdy'.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE RaggedCloth/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE RaggedCloth/S.en: Yeah, I know - I'm not contesting that.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE RaggedCloth/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.en: Soon after I arrived - just once, and then it vanished.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.pl: Wkrótce po mym przybyciu - raz jeden, po czym zniknęła.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.en: ...it comes to mind I saw this map upon the captain’s cabin-desk.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.pl: ...przypominam sobie, iż widziałam tę mapę na biurku w kajucie kapitańskiej.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.en: A map that leadeth unto naught...?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.en: What d'you mean? It leads to that big red X.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.pl: Co masz na myśli? Prowadzi do tego wielkiego czerwonego X.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.en: Yeah, but it's a big red X in the middle of the ocean.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.pl: Tak, ale to wielkie czerwone X na środku oceanu.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SeaChart/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.en: Yet another weight upon his ever-troubl'd mind.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.pl: Jeszcze jeden ciężar na jego wiecznie strapionym umyśle.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.en: Although, given that it's sealed in glass, I imagine it's now [i]very[/i] hard to fix...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.pl: Aczkolwiek, zważywszy, że zapieczętowany jest w szkle, wyobrażam sobie, że teraz [i]bardzo[/i] trudno go naprawić...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.en: It's broken. Some part of its [i]innards[/i] has come loose.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.pl: Jest zepsuty. Jakaś część jego [i]wnętrzności[/i] się obluzowała.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.en: D'you know anything about Mortuga's model ship?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipinaBottle.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipsWheel/Se.en: To turn the wheel. To steer the ship.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipsWheel/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipsWheel/Se.en: It did not. I was too weak.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE ShipsWheel/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.en: Against all odds, I've been inscribed, upon this family tree.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.pl: Wbrew wszelkim przeciwnościom, wpisano mnie na to drzewo genealogiczne.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.en: Bound only by the bloodline of my matron's former kin.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.pl: Związana jedynie krwią rodu dawnej rodziny mej opiekunki.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.en: No longer tied to Fellow-name, she styles herself as [i]‘Baroness’.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.pl: Już nie związana z nazwiskiem Fellow, mianuje się [i]'Baronową'.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.en: Sym, look - you've got two half-brothers. Kinda.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.pl: Sym, spójrz - masz dwóch przyrodnich braci. Niby.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.en: Only in the faintest terms - but there they are. Flint and Felix.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.pl: Jedynie w najsłabszym sensie - lecz oto oni są. Flint i Felix.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.en: We've actually [i]met[/i] Felix. Would you believe that?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SilkwirmMap/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SubmarineBlue.en: She tries her best to honor fate and call it by its newest name...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SubmarineBlue.pl: Stara się, jak może, uhonorować los i nazywać ją najnowszym imieniem...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SubmarineBlue.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SubmarineBlue.en: I will admit, in quiet hours, the former name returns.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SubmarineBlue.pl: Przyznam, że w cichych godzinach, dawne imię powraca.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SubmarineBlue.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SubmarineBlue.en: Need you only glance beneath a single-slip of paper.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SubmarineBlue.pl: Wystarczy jedynie zerknąć pod pojedynczy skrawek papieru.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SubmarineBlue.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.en: Why would someone bring-along a bottled form of sun...?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.pl: Czemuż ktoś zabrałby ze sobą butelkową postać słońca...?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.en: Sunlight's good for you - [i]Vitamin D[/i], I guess.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.pl: Światło słoneczne jest dla ciebie dobre - [i]Witamina D,[/i] jak sądzę.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.en: If you don't get enough, it makes you sad.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.pl: Jeśli nie dostaniesz go wystarczająco, robisz się smutny.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.en: [i]Silkwirm's[/i] sun is scantly seen... Even in a [i]summer[/i] sky.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.pl: [i]Silkwirmowe[/i] słońce skąpo się spostrzega... Skoro nawet w [i]letnim[/i] niebie.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.en: I swear, sometimes she just gets [i]lucky[/i] with the alliteration.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.pl: Przysięgam, czasem po prostu ma [i]szczęście[/i] z aliteracją.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.en: You know how people tend to be happier in summer and sadder in winter?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.pl: Wiesz, jak ludzie zwykle są szczęśliwsi latem, a smutniejsi zimą?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE SunTablets/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.en: Wirman likes [i]writing[/i] on it, I guess.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.pl: Wirman lubi na niej [i]pisać,[/i] jak sądzę.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.en: I think it's just as likely to be the exact opposite.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.pl: Myślę, że równie prawdopodobne jest coś dokładnie odwrotnego.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.en: That he's here because he [i]doesn't[/i] want to write that book.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.pl: Że jest tutaj, bo [i]nie chce[/i] pisać tej książki.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.en: It's so [i]heavy[/i] - I can't imagine lugging this around everywhere.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.pl: Jest taka [i]ciężka[/i] - nie wyobrażam sobie taszczenia tego wszędzie.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.en: -and, supposedly, that's the whole reason he's here? To write his next book?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.pl: -i, podobno, to cały powód, dla którego tu jest? Żeby napisać kolejną książkę?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.en: That he's here to [i]hide[/i] from it.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.pl: Że jest tutaj, by się przed nią [i]ukryć.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE Typewriter/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.en: But now I feel like we should check under Sinthia's mattress.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.pl: Ale teraz czuję, że powinniśmy sprawdzić pod materacem Sinthii.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.en: I've only ever heard her voice...
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.en: I don't know. I've never seen her with my eyes.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.pl: Nie wiem. Nigdy nie widziałam jej na własne oczy.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.en:
I wish I knew.
O, how I [i]wish[/i] I knew.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.pl: W nocy, gdy w pół śnie.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.en: If you've never [i]seen[/i] her, how'd you recognise her from the photo?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.pl: Jeśli nigdy jej nie [i]widziałaś,[/i] jak rozpoznałaś ją na zdjęciu?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.en: -may I ask where you found it?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.en: Actually, it was in your bedroom.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.pl: Właściwie, było to w twojej sypialni.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.en: O - [i]this[/i] is what Sinthia was hiding under her mattress?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.pl: O - [i]to[/i] jest to, co Sinthia ukrywała pod materacem?
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.en: No... we found it in a [i]safe.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE UnderwaterPho.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenBuoy/Se.en: The fate awaiting guilty hearts once they are condemned!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenBuoy/Se.pl: Los czekający winne serca, gdy już zostaną skazane!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenBuoy/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenBuoy/Se.en: Nay! Bound in chains upon the deck! And pulled along beside the ship!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenBuoy/Se.pl: Nie! Skute w łańcuchy na pokładzie! I ciągnięte wzdłuż burty statku!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenBuoy/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenBuoy/Se.en: What - you get turned into a [i]weird little wooden goblin head?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenBuoy/Se.pl: Co - zmieniasz się w [i]dziwną, małą drewnianą głowę goblina?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenBuoy/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenPipe/Se.en: O! I know this game! One always tells the truth, and the other always lies!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenPipe/Se.pl: O! Znam tę grę! Jedno zawsze mówi prawdę, a drugie zawsze kłamie!
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenPipe/Se.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenPipe/Se.en: Uh, no, that's not what's happening.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenPipe/Se.pl: Yy, nie, to nie o to chodzi.
Conversation/Symmetry CLUE WoodenPipe/Se.speaker: Grimoire
